en.headline: Neon archive show at Blue Lotus closes on Sunday
en.dek: Keith Macgregor's City of Lights runs at the Sheung Wan gallery through 4 October, documenting Hong Kong neon from the 1990s and 2000s.
body: Blue Lotus Gallery is showing City of Lights, a photography exhibition by Keith Macgregor, at 28 Pound Lane in Tai Ping Shan, Sheung Wan. The gallery lists the run from 18 June until 7:30pm on Sunday, 4 October.

The gallery describes the show as an archive of Hong Kong neon signage from the 1990s and 2000s, published alongside a book of previously unseen images. It says the city had more than 100,000 neon signs at the peak in the 1980s, and that fewer than 400 remain.

Macgregor said he once treated neon as urban wallpaper, and later wanted to record the skill and engineering behind the signs. The listed close is Sunday, so the Sheung Wan exhibition is in its final weekend.

zh.headline: 上環藍蓮畫廊霓虹攝影展周日結束
zh.dek: 攝影師Keith Macgregor的City of Lights在太平山街磅巷展至十月四日，記錄九十及二千年代香港霓虹。
body: 上環太平山街磅巷28號藍蓮畫廊正在展出攝影師Keith Macgregor的攝影展City of Lights。畫廊列出的展期由六月十八日至十月四日（星期日）晚上7時30分。
畫廊形容展覽是一九九零及二零零零年代香港霓虹招牌的影像紀錄，並配合一本收錄未發表照片的書。畫廊指，一九八零年代全盛時期本港霓虹招牌超過十萬塊，現時剩下不足四百塊。
Macgregor說，年輕時把霓虹當作城市牆紙，後來才想記下招牌背後的手藝和工程。畫廊列出的結束日是星期日，展覽正處於最後一個周末。
